verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online exposes REST APIs and SDKs (Node.js OAuth client, PHP SDK) and an official MCP server with 145 tools, which lets automation scripts or agents interact with QBO programmatically outside the UI — a form of headless operation. However, there is no documentation of a CLI, headless test harness, or CI-specific tooling, and QBO is fundamentally a hosted web app, not something 'run' in a pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless-mode documentation, sandbox/test-mode automation guidance, and independent confirmation of automated end-to-end runs.
